claims.title: Pulp recovery generates a difficult liquid waste stream
claims.proposition: The researchers produced cellulose pulp by alkaline treatment. Their dark process liquor contained metals and organic compounds. The treatment sequence did not reduce chemical oxygen demand to an acceptable level in their tests; the paper also reports reuse of clarified liquor over several cooking cycles.

claims.title: Filter fibre changed the properties of asphalt binder
claims.proposition: The paper describes adding cigarette butt fibre to several bitumen binders and comparing them with controls. The authors report improved binder drain-off behaviour under their test conditions; the penetration response varied by binder.

claims.title: A second asphalt study measured mixture performance
claims.proposition: The study describes incorporating cigarette butts into an asphalt mixture and comparing Marshall and rutting test results with an ordinary mixture.

claims.title: Spent filters released microfibres in water tests
claims.proposition: The authors reported detachment of fibres from smoked filters in water; the fibre-release work was on smoked filters under study conditions, not on a recycling plant wash stream.

claims.title: A laboratory study tested a butt-derived fibre blend for air filtration
claims.proposition: The authors used recovered cellulose acetate from cigarette butts with polyacrylonitrile to make prototype nanofibre membranes and measured particle filtration and pressure drop.

claims.title: A laboratory study used recovered cellulose fibres as a catalyst support
claims.proposition: The researchers incorporated recovered cigarette butt cellulose fibres into a photocatalyst composite and evaluated it against model dye solutions.

claims.title: A patent describes extraction before making an insulation product
claims.proposition: A French patent document describes using a supercritical fluid to extract residues from cigarette filters for a proposed insulation application. This is a disclosed route rather than operating evidence.

claims.title: TerraCycle describes splitting paper and tobacco from the filters
claims.proposition: TerraCycle says it sends separated paper and tobacco to composting, cleans and pelletises the filters by extrusion, and blends the plastic with other polymers for products.

claims.title: Trade reporting describes Code Effort’s different output streams
claims.proposition: The article describes fibre for stuffing, a paper-derived product, and composting of separated tobacco. It describes chemical treatment broadly; this is not an independent verification of product quality or contaminant fate.

claims.title: A provincial authorisation documents one site and product route
claims.proposition: The authorisation describes a site-specific route that includes sorting, washing and drying, followed by thermal mixing and granulation. The annex sets conformity requirements for the recovered material; the listed material criteria in Table 2 do not include the four metals tracked by Butt Lab.
